section.title: Career Journey
section.description: A verified record of full-stack development, AI system integration, and technical research internships across real-world business and research environments.

experiences.overview: Contributing to full-stack development for e-commerce operations, with a focus on order management, inventory workflows, and system integrations. Working across backend services, API integrations, and data processing to improve operational reliability and streamline business processes.

Contributed to multiple AI and full-stack applications, combining modern web technologies with backend services and AI/ML capabilities. Worked on projects involving AI chatbots, predictive maintenance dashboards, voice-enabled assistants, PPE detection, warehouse surveillance, and digital signage systems. Developed responsive interfaces, integrated REST APIs and AI models, implemented real-time functionality, and supported end-to-end application development and debugging.

Contributed to technical research and authored a technical review paper. Presented research findings to senior professionals, strengthening my ability to analyze technical literature, evaluate information, and communicate complex concepts clearly.
